verdicts.reason: Both use the same layout: a heavily cropped, blurry background with the headline over the busy pillar and doorway. The headline also wraps raggedly, with 'FURNITURE DESIGN' jutting out far past the other lines. In both, the two text boxes are pinned to the right edge and the bottom fifth is empty floor. A spaces the headline, blue box and black box more evenly (gaps of about 75 and 60 px). B jams the blue box up under the headline (about 33 px) and leaves a big gap (about 100 px) before the black box, so A is slightly better.
